purpose: Teach: 一撃/行財政/主審/官民/裏づけ/等価/定型/総勢

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、業界に一撃を与える新製品を出せ
lines.en: I want us to deliver a product that shakes the industry.
lines.style: Sharp, commanding. Direct eye contact. Each word lands with weight. No negotiation in the tone—this is what needs to happen.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。行財政改革の動向を注視します
lines.en: Understood. I'll monitor the administrative and financial reform developments closely.
lines.style: Measured, professional. Respectful nod of acknowledgment. Steady voice—showing he's taking this seriously and tracking every detail.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、入札の主審査委員を派遣しろ
lines.en: Send someone to chair the bid evaluation committee.
lines.style: Clipped, decisive. Slight lean forward. No room for questions—expectation is crystal clear.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。官民連携プロジェクトを進めます
lines.en: Yes. I'll move the public-private partnership project forward.
lines.style: Assured, steady. A slight nod. Calm confidence—he's already thinking through the next steps.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 成功事例の裏づけデータを示せ
lines.en: Show me the data backing up our success cases.
lines.style: Demanding but not harsh. Eyes narrow slightly. Wants proof, not promises. Waits for the answer without filling the silence.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。社員の給与は等価交換の原則を保ちます
lines.en: Yes. I'll ensure our employee compensation structure maintains fair exchange principles.
lines.style: Formal, precise. Measured pace. Each syllable deliberate—he's confirming alignment with company values.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 定型業務を自動化しろ
lines.style: Economical, sharp. Minimal words, maximum clarity. The finality of someone used to being heard.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。総勢百名の社員旅行を計画します
lines.en: Understood. I'll organize the company trip for all one hundred staff members.
lines.style: Affirmative, closing the meeting. Professional but with a slight warmth beneath—he's heard the directives and is ready to execute.
